description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and various accuracy metrics, including Final Accuracy, change in Accuracy (Δ Acc), and Initial Accuracy. The x-axis represents Initial Confidence, with a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, and tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents Accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot displays three lines: Final Acc, represented by a solid blue line with cross markers, starts at approximately 0.88 at an Initial Confidence of 0.95 and increases to around 0.86 at 0.99; Δ Acc, represented by a dashed orange line with diamond markers, begins at about 0.88 at 0.95 and decreases to roughly 0.72 at 0.99; Initial Acc, represented by a dash-dot green line with square markers, starts at nearly 0 at 0.95 and rises to approximately 0.12 at 0.99.
